data_plan: 15-minute bars, crypto30 panel (the 30 Binance USDT-M symbols of rd2/panels.py CRYPTO30), Binance Vision monthly klines via the programme's verified loader (data_feed.load_dataset) — the identical panel and loader the Box Theory declared run used (months 2023-10..2026-10, 108,192 bars per symbol, zero missing bars; provenance pattern of ig/box_theory_provenance.json). Free and keyless; no new data source is introduced. The run must state the exact panel, source and date range it used and apply walk-forward folds per programme convention. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring PR.

declared_conventions.breakeven_evaluation: The source says 'when price has moved half of the target, move the SL to breakeven' without bar-level mechanics. Convention: the 1.5R trigger is evaluated on bar extremes from the bar AFTER entry onward; once a bar's extreme reaches the trigger, the stop is at entry from the NEXT bar onward; within the trigger bar itself the ORIGINAL stop is checked first (worst case). A trade whose stop was moved to breakeven and is then stopped exits at entry price (0R before costs).
declared_conventions.degenerate_risk: If the trigger candle's extreme equals the entry close (zero stop distance), or the computed target distance is zero, the signal produces NO trade. No minimum-R floor is imposed — imposing one would be a variant.
declared_conventions.opposite_crossover: NOT STATED in the source. Convention: an opposite crossover does NOT close an open position; the position runs to its stop / breakeven-stop / target only. Crossovers arriving while a position is open on that symbol are skipped (one position at a time per symbol, the harness practice of the Box run).
declared_conventions.panel_scope: The source EA is instrument-agnostic (it runs on whichever MT5 chart it is attached to) and names no instrument. Convention: v1 tests the crypto30 15m panel ONLY — the fleet's one provenance-verified 15m panel. A forex or equities leg would require its own declaration (forex_cross41 has no verified 15m history per TASK-STR-DATA-001).
declared_conventions.position_sizing: The source states 1% risk per trade. Recorded as a source rule; it is not part of this family's backtest identity — the bar judges per-trade expectancy / profit factor, which are sizing-invariant. If the candidate ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged, as with SRS.
declared_conventions.stop_placement: The source says the stop-loss sits 'below the recently closed candle' (long) / 'above the recently closed candle high' (short) without stating a distance. Convention: the stop sits AT the trigger candle's extreme — long stop = low of bar i, short stop = high of bar i — with zero buffer. Any buffer beyond the extreme would be an invented parameter, so none is imposed; adding one would be a variant.

evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model AND a 2x-cost shadow run, both must pass; exits simulated under the harness convention (signal on close of bar i -> position managed from bar i+1, stop-before-target worst case)
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only; parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni against the programme trial floor at run time (programme counter = 3,891 executed trials as of 2026-11-17 per the rd-reconcile ledger; this declaration adds exactly ONE trial — a single frozen cell — and the run must state the floor it used)

hypothesis: On 15-minute bars, a completed EMA(5)/EMA(11) crossover traded in the direction of the cross, with the stop beyond the trigger candle's extreme, a fixed 3R target and the stop moved to breakeven at half target (1.5R), captures enough short-horizon trend persistence to clear the RD programme bar net of costs — the payoff asymmetry (3R wins against 1R losses, with breakeven conversion at 1.5R) doing the work that raw crossover direction alone has not done at higher timeframes.
promotion_path: Passing the bar makes this a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>=100 trades AND >=8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.breakeven: when price reaches +1.5R (half of the 3R target distance) the stop moves to the entry price (see declared_conventions.breakeven_evaluation)
rules.ema: EMA(5) and EMA(11) on bar closes, standard EMA recursion (k = 2/(n+1)), computed over the full loaded series per symbol; a crossover can only be evaluated once both EMAs exist
rules.entry_long: EMA(5) crosses from at-or-below EMA(11) on the previous bar to above EMA(11) on bar i, evaluated on COMPLETED bars only ('entries only after the EMA crossover is completed'); entry at bar i's close
rules.entry_short: mirror: EMA(5) crosses from at-or-above to below; entry at bar i's close
rules.frequency: one position at a time per symbol; crossovers while a position is open are skipped; no cap on trades per day (the source states none)
rules.no_lookahead: the crossover uses only bars up to and including bar i; the position is managed from bar i+1 onward
rules.parameters_fixed: EMA_FAST=5, EMA_SLOW=11, RR_TARGET=3.0, BE_TRIGGER_R=1.5 — no other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count
rules.stop_long: below the recently closed (trigger) candle: stop = low of bar i, the bar on which the crossover completed
rules.stop_short: above the recently closed (trigger) candle: stop = high of bar i
rules.target: entry +/- 3.0 x initial risk (1:3 risk-to-reward as stated in the source); initial risk = |entry - stop|

source: IG corpus item DYpKBKgKkoJ (@tendul_siva) — packaged by the IG full-watch programme as candidate S-RD1 (ig-fullwatch/packages/stratex.md). The reel itself is an MT5-bot tutorial promo; the strategy's complete rules were recovered from the creator's own YouTube tutorial (channel 'Crypto Tendul siva', 'How to create a trading bot in Meta trader 5 | Expert advisor | Algo trading', 2026-05-21) captions + description, recorded verbatim in the item file: 15m timeframe; plot 5 EMA and 11 EMA; completed crossover from below -> market BUY with stop-loss below the recently closed candle; crossover from above -> market SELL with stop-loss above the recently closed candle high; risk per trade 1% of balance; risk-to-reward 1:3; when price has moved half of the target, move the SL to breakeven; entries only after the EMA crossover is completed. Evidence note (explicit): the rules come from the creator's YouTube tutorial, NOT from the reel itself, whose own subtitle track is still unexposed. The creator's '1500% return over two and a half months' claim is unverified — he himself corrected it in the item's comments (a 1500% gain does not mean 1500% profit) — and is treated as such: it bought this family a pre-declared test, nothing more. The prop-firm / VPS material in the item is not adopted.
